assumptions.statement: The repository overall polygon and three key-area rectangles are rough provisional constraints, not official redlines or site survey polygons.
assumptions.impact: All spatial layers and derived metrics are concept carriers and must be regenerated when canonical geometry is published.

assumptions.statement: Statutory land use, title, road redlines, existing buildings, underground utilities, drainage, fire, heritage, construction and traffic-control data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No route, occupation edge, building, component, area ratio or point is an engineering or approval conclusion.

assumptions.statement: The Qinghua East Road South public-space project is a real approved project with a named construction unit and a public plan to start in 2026, but no relationship with this submission is authorized.
assumptions.impact: It is a priority engagement candidate only; the proposal cannot map its redline, claim adoption or describe a real pilot as active.

assumptions.statement: The applicable occupation, traffic, construction, green-space, rail, fire, event and facility permissions depend on the real site and work and are not assumed complete.
assumptions.impact: The event remains UNKNOWN/PREPARING until authorized documents and competent reviewers are named.

assumptions.statement: No real temporary passage alignment, width, slope, surface, turning space, crossing, lighting, drainage, tactile guidance or edge protection has been measured or approved.
assumptions.impact: The package defines required evidence fields and spatial relationships, never exact local dimensions or accessible-compliance claims.

assumptions.statement: No contractor, supervisor, road/facility manager, accessibility reviewer, daily inspector, insurer or restoration signatory is assumed committed.
assumptions.impact: Public reports and AI cannot move an event into VERIFIED_PASSAGE, ACTIVE or RESTORED.

assumptions.statement: The minimum event model contains no name, phone, account, face, license plate, precise individual position, image, continuous location or personal trajectory.
assumptions.impact: Discovery of prohibited fields stops collection and triggers deletion/escalation; only public event, aggregate status and accountable-role evidence are permitted.

assumptions.statement: No two comparable quotes, bill of quantities, labour baseline, insurance cost or approved budget is available for the proposed trial.
assumptions.impact: Only cost buckets are stated; real-site admission requires comparable evidence and an accountable payer.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day sequence is a falsifiable design proposal, not an announced government programme or a construction instruction.
assumptions.impact: It may remain a desk/authorized shadow exercise, shrink, pause or stop when authority, safety, workload, cost or evidence gates fail.

assumptions.statement: Document parsing, expiry alerts and easy-read drafting may not outperform a paper checklist, named phone chain and manual inspection.
assumptions.impact: AI is tested only after the non-AI baseline; if it fails to reduce missing evidence or time without creating false-ready states, AI exits.

assumptions.statement: A member of the public may report a clue and test whether a notice is understandable but cannot approve occupation, inspect engineering safety, direct traffic, maintain barriers or certify restoration.
assumptions.impact: Volunteer labour never substitutes for construction, supervision, authority, professional inspection or daily maintenance.

assumptions.statement: Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin and Dazhongsi are taskbook names linked to provisional rectangles; proposed functions are not existing laboratories, contracts, stations, roadworks or public services.
assumptions.impact: Field survey, title, operator, road/facility status and professional review precede all site placement.
